title: ATUS aggregate sleep-duration plausibility alternative

numerical_tolerances.sleep_duration_absolute_error_minutes: less than or equal to the frozen 30-minute activity-duration screen
numerical_tolerances.distribution_evidence: respondent-level timing, duration, frequency, transition, and variability evidence required

known_deviations: DBnomics is an access mirror; BLS is the underlying ATUS aggregate-series provider.
The mirror snapshot ends in 2023 and contains aggregate LABSTAT estimates rather than respondent diary microdata.
The comparison uses a 30-day deterministic production object-runner output; the decision target is provenance only.
The former 300-minute sleep-episode discontinuity is repaired and no complete diagnostic episode ends there.
The duration screen still fails and individual-distribution evidence is unavailable; this is a rejected alternative.
The array engine is excluded until its fixed-duration sleep execution conforms to the object contract.
